title: Paired states and Hamiltonian cycles in cubic bipartite planar graphs
summary: We prove Barnette's conjecture: every finite simple cubic bipartite planar 3-vertex-connected graph has a Hamiltonian cycle.

review.reason: Proves Barnette's conjecture that cubic bipartite 3-connected planar graphs are Hamiltonian.

discussion.title: A note on the proof of Barnette's conjecture
discussion.author: Zhentao Li
discussion.text: Barnette's conjecture states that every cubic 3-connected bipartite planar graph has a Hamiltonian cycle. We present a digested exposition of OpenAI's generated proof of Barnette's conjecture \cite{openai-barnette}.
